source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 9.2 Cu. Ft. Steam Dryer Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered. Use Key Activation, fault scroll, or Service Test as needed, then continue below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After diagnostic entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Access UI service LEDs
steps.body: Separate glass top from UI frame. Locate amber Service Power, blue Service Data, white Service Button Sounds LEDs.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Separate glass top from UI frame. Locate amber Service Power, blue Service Data, white Service Button Sounds LEDs.

images.caption: Removing top panel and console/HMI (W11737351 p.8)

steps.title: Service Power (amber)
steps.body: Flashes 1 Hz when UI powered. No flash → check UI harness and connections.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Flashes 1 Hz when UI powered. No flash → check UI harness and connections.

steps.title: Service Data (blue)
steps.body: Illuminates/flashes when ACU↔UI comm OK. Cycle POWER or replug — if still dark, check harness and ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Illuminates/flashes when ACU↔UI comm OK. Cycle POWER or replug — if still dark, check harness and ACU.

steps.title: Service Button Sounds (white)
steps.body: On when Control Lock off and Audio Level not muted. Hold STEAM REFRESH 3 sec to toggle lock; use AUDIO LEVEL if muted.
steps.sourceExcerpt: On when Control Lock off and Audio Level not muted. Hold STEAM REFRESH 3 sec to toggle lock; use AUDIO LEVEL if muted.

steps.title: Check harness
steps.oemOutcome: Verify UI harness continuity and connector seating.

steps.title: Replace UI
steps.oemOutcome: Replace UI when all three service LEDs fail after harness OK.

steps.title: Service LEDs verified
steps.oemOutcome: All three UI service LEDs behave per manual.
